title: "calibrated using readings from last 4 days" (or words to that effect error)
symptom: xDrip is reading 17.8 mmol/L and has been in for just over 4 days. The user tried to calibrate but an error appears saying it is ignoring the calibration because it likes data from a few days ago better.
cause: The error means it is using more than 4 days worth of data because it doesn't have so many calibrations from the last few days.
evidence_quote: It just means its using more than 4 days worth of data as it doesn't have so many calibrations from the last few days.
